title: Record an optional baseline floor on the cap trace
action: Let a cap record an OPTIONAL baseline floor: what the SAME verify command did on the base commit (D5). Two touch points, both mirroring shapes that already exist. (1) finish_support.rs: REPORT_OPTIONAL_KEYS is today ["mistakes"] — add the floor as a SECOND optional report key, validated the same way mistakes is: present-but-malformed refuses by name, absent records nothing and is never read as a negative. Its value carries at least the base commit it was measured on and the result the command produced there; keep the shape minimal and structured, not prose. (2) trace.rs: add the field to default_trace() beside verification_evidence / verify_output / verify_passed / verify_command, and ALSO add it to the key list in release_trace(), because it is verify evidence and must not survive a release into a re-claimed cell — that list is exactly where the other four are cleared. STRICT PROHIBITIONS, each load-bearing: do NOT touch parse_tests_proof (finish_support.rs:91-123) — not its signature, not its two-separator split, not its blindness to the result vocabulary; its own comment records that tightening there retroactively refuses ~200 historical caps carrying a bare green, and D3 forbids it. Do NOT add a fourth proof-string segment. Do NOT add a refusal anywhere for a MISSING floor — not in the cap, not in feature_proof_check, not in any close or merge door (D2, D4); absent is legal and silent. Author tests covering: a cap with a well-formed floor records it on the trace; a cap with NO floor succeeds unchanged and leaves the field null; a malformed floor refuses by name; release_trace clears the field; and a pre-existing cap whose report has no such key still parses.
verify: PATH="${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}/bin:$PATH" cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml -p bee --bin bee cells

truths: A cap may carry a baseline floor and it lands on the trace as structured data
A cap with no floor succeeds exactly as before
No door refuses a cap for lacking a floor
Releasing a cell clears the floor along with the other verify evidence

artifacts.substantive: the floor accepted as a second optional report key with its own validation; parse_tests_proof untouched
the field in default_trace and in release_trace's cleared list

key_links: the floor sits with verify_command, verify_output, verify_passed and verification_evidence in both trace functions
prohibitions: No change to parse_tests_proof's signature, split rule or vocabulary blindness
No fourth segment on the proof string
No refusal anywhere for a missing floor
No change to feature_proof_check's verdict for any existing cap

checks.evidence: trace.rs gains `m.insert("baseline_floor".into(), Value::Null)` in default_trace, beside the other verify-evidence fields. Structured, not a proof-string segment.
Zero +/- lines touch fn parse_tests_proof and zero touch PROOF_SEPARATOR, so the proof string's shape and its two-separator split are exactly as before.

REPORT_OPTIONAL_KEYS grew from ["mistakes"] to ["mistakes", "baseline_floor"] — the existing optional-key mechanism, which treats absence as silent. Test cap_with_no_baseline_floor_succeeds_unchanged_and_leaves_field_null pins it.

The ~200 historical caps carrying a bare `green` are unaffected: the read path's parser is byte-identical, and test pre_existing_cap_report_without_baseline_floor_still_parses pins the old report shape.

The only refusal added is for a MALFORMED floor, named by key (cap_with_malformed_baseline_floor_refuses_by_name) — the same posture `mistakes` already has. Nothing refuses a cap for lacking a floor, in the cap or in feature_proof_check.

"baseline_floor" was added to release_trace's key array, so a released cell does not carry stale verify evidence into a re-claim. Test release_trace_clears_baseline_floor pins it. This was the half most likely to be missed.
Leader re-ran the cell's declared verify independently after the commit: cargo test --release -p bee --bin bee cells -> 'test result: ok. 378 passed; 0 failed'.
